title: 第1005章 天级雷境第1004章 万古雷发
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
宇宙苍穹，古玄世界灰暗幽空，雷反震道，电光闪烁，万朵厚厚雷云压顶，电闪雷鸣宛如罚世。
帝子云被雷发肢解的身体终于回归一体，如同天地间最年轻帝尊傲立苍穹。
他已经接受了八道雷发，只等第九重九道雷发结束，他便正道天级雷境，成为半神。他的披肩长发每一根发丝如雪带着电光闪烁。
他的金色覆盖青红的混沌阴阳星瞳如今银芒如辉，散发着雄浑雷电射线光，即使帝境被盯上，一眼销魂。他伟岸的身躯傲立苍穹缓步虚空。
因他还在继续吞噬满天游离雷电，如此宝物，他觉得放过一丝都是极大的浪费犯罪，这是万古宇宙赐予他独有宇宙霸体大晋级最好礼物。
而让他诧异的是，雷发已经进入第九天，第九道正道雷发久久不能落下，让他去留无主，唯有不停的吞噬苍穹游离雷电。
“嗯？雷云电云之中似乎人影？这倒是万古奇闻，难道雷发与雷罚皆由人为操控？不行，管你雷发不雷发，本主就是好奇，务必一探究竟，否则寝食难安。”
正道雷发久久不能落下，却在帝子云头顶聚集越来越厚的雷云电云宛如苍穹大海。厚厚的云层大到无边，仿佛布满苍穹，而不知道有多少层雷云电云，因帝子云已经飞了九层，只感觉云层仿佛永远飞不完。
帝子云如今魔龙黑翼展翅便是十万里，瞬间到达。然他已展翅无数次，他感觉雷云电云在随着他飞升而整体提升，这简直不可思议。
越是如此，他越要一探究竟，妖孽就是不能让自己有心结，必须通透清爽方可高枕无忧。然，作为雷击境半神，他忽然间感应到一位在他生命中不可或缺之人也在晋升雷击境，一霎那了然于胸；
“剑锏法器，你不用护道本主，去护道铁木呼延娜娜公主。她是前世瑾天帝亲封瑾天帝后，哦，你知道她是你的女主就好。本主不能让她的万载孤独轮回守候痛苦一场空。去吧！”
剑锏法器吞噬无尽雷电能量恢复更强战力，心满意足的如流星划破天际去了铁木大部落草原方向。无需谁指引，因，它是瑾天帝帝尊级主战兵器，而呼延娜娜公主乃瑾天帝唯一亲封瑾天帝后。
百多万载未见女主，剑锏法器也是激动不已。但漫天雷电超燃能量，它又感觉吞噬意犹未尽。放缓速度大吞特吞，恨不得一口吞下一重天，大阴间阴曹地府地狱之下出生的它心比天高，命比金贵。
而帝子云在层层雷云电云飞升中缓下来，因漫天银蛇乱舞，雷龙狂飙，劈头盖脑的便击中帝子云。帝子云的意念魂魄大军霎那间成千上万飞出，一个抱着一根闪电雷龙狂啃，让远躲幽空的万界神灵瞠目结舌。
包括逆神天庭伪神神圣，如此灭世雷法万古绝无仅有。然，如此恐怖如斯雷发，那个人间伪神一举突破雷击境，而他接受雷发正道宇宙霸体，塔酿滴几乎都在反吞噬雷发，这还是人吗？
其实包括逆神天庭伪神在内都很瞧不起这个人族半神，他们能看出帝子云已经两千多岁。两千多岁方才晋升半神，对诸天万界来说，太普通了，普通到大龄青年还没有找到老婆一般没用。
一般真正的天之骄子，千年便雷罚正神。而帝子云才堪堪雷击境，与千年雷罚正神差了一千多年差距，已经是修炼垃圾。
然，当他们看到这个修炼垃圾恐怖灭世万古雷法时，而且前无古人的肢解身体奇葩雷法时，逆神天庭伪神都瞠目结舌，这尼玛不是人，乃怪物也。
于是，他们拿定主意，务必把这个还在半神雷发的怪物扣杀摇篮中。他们认为下界低贱人族行的他们高高在上天神必定手到擒来。
于是乎，在第五道雷发间隙伺机而动，不出帝子云所料，逆神天庭神圣黑手不期而至。然，他们的悲剧可想而知，这可是从未有过之万古雷发，一触即发。

对应帝子云逆天妖孽的更强雷发一瞬间把下黑手的逆神天庭伪神雷击电罚成为灰烟，被帝子云一口天魔吞成为帝子云的晋级养料。
逆神天庭伪神多半都是神的后裔或者古神后裔，乃大补，全面提升帝子云本体以及神通法术，帝子云意犹未尽。可惜布满苍穹的雷发落下，帝子云不得不应付雷发。而吃一堑长一智的逆神天庭神圣不得不远离这个恐怖如斯人间怪物。
~~~帝子云的第九道雷发史无前例，布满苍穹的层层雷云电云雷发一层一层宛若游龙满天落下，让帝子云防不胜防。即使冥冥之中天道不肢解他的身体，恐怖灭绝的雷发仍然崩得他血肉横飞。
然，他怎舍得自己的宇宙霸体有一丝丝欠缺，身之肤发受之父母，连带着雷电能量统统吞噬回来。帝子云仍然不死心，一边接受雷发正道，一边倔强的往天上飞。
他发现雷电云层一层比一层厚实，飞到第九十九层，雷电云层宛如铜墙铁壁，但帝子云根本不死心，如此神秘，务必一探究竟。
“星雷剑罡，破！”。忍无可忍的帝子云唤出青锋古剑顶住漫天雷龙银蛇一剑斩向第九十九道雷电云层，为了破第九十九道云层，帝子云整整耗费九十九天。
终于，在他一边星辰剑罡大力劈砍，一边不能浪费，连砍碎的雷电云层都一起吞噬，在他累到吐血时，厚厚的雷电云层终于忽然打通一根裂缝，射线光宛如逆光差一点把帝子云射瞎。
而这些射线光代表更强电流雷击原始本源，帝子云服下神药稳定了些许双眼放光；
“我的，我的，如此等待揉捏本主，必定就是先磨其筋骨，伤其皮肉，而后等本主来统统吞噬。雷电本源啊，本主独一份，谁与争锋？”
帝子云比看见帝尊小仙女都双眼放光，疯狂的星辰剑罡劈开缺口，一只脚等待不及便从裂缝挤了进去；“卧槽，额勒个去，阿妈呀！”
然而，帝子云强行挤进第九十九层的那只脚感觉被雷霆万钧重击轰成了渣，电流雷击本源传遍全身，通体只见电流宛如银龙游离，帝子云只想说，麻了，麻木了，身体不是自己的了。
“还有没有天理啊，脚就更不是自己的了！”。帝子云强忍雷击电流本源穿透全身，双手抱腿用力扯出。
看着不知被何物重击成为跟扫帚一般残缺不全的大腿，雷电本源宛如黑金与水银化浆布满，腿脚完全失去知觉，剑眉倒竖；

content_en:
In the sky of the universe and the dark sky of the ancient mysterious world, thunder and lightning flashed, thousands of thick thunderclouds pressed down on the top, and the lightning and thunder were like punishment on the world.
Di Ziyun's body dismembered by thunder finally returned to one body, standing proudly in the sky like the youngest emperor in the world.
He has already accepted the eight thunders, and when the ninth and nine thunders are over, he will reach the heaven-level thunder realm and become a demigod. Every strand of his long shawl hair shimmered like snow with electric light.
His golden-covered cyan-red Chaos Yin-Yang Star Pupils are now silvery and glowing, exuding powerful thunder and lightning rays. Even if the emperor is targeted, he will be ecstatic at a glance. His majestic body stands proudly in the sky and slowly walks into the void.
Because he was still devouring the sky full of free thunder and lightning, he felt that letting go of such a treasure would be a huge waste of crime. This was the best gift given to him by the eternal universe to advance to the unique cosmic hegemony.
What surprised him was that the thunder had already entered the ninth day, and the thunder of the ninth righteous path could not fall for a long time. He was left without a master, and could only keep swallowing the free thunder and lightning in the sky.
"Huh? There seems to be a human figure in the thunder and lightning clouds? This is an eternal anecdote. Are thunder and thunder punishments controlled by humans? No, it doesn't matter whether you are thunder or not, I am just curious. I must find out, otherwise I will have trouble sleeping and eating."
The thunder of the righteous path could not fall for a long time, but the thunder clouds and lightning clouds gathered thicker and thicker above the head of Emperor Ziyun, like the sky and the sea. The thick clouds were so huge that they seemed to cover the sky, and there were no one knew how many layers of thunder clouds and lightning clouds there were. Because the Emperor Cloud had already flown nine layers, it felt like the clouds would never finish flying.
Di Ziyun said that the magic dragon's black wings could now spread out over a hundred thousand miles and arrive in an instant. However, he had spread his wings countless times, and he felt that the thunder clouds and lightning clouds were improving as a whole as he soared. This was simply incredible.
The more this happened, the more he wanted to find out. The evildoer couldn't let himself have knots in his mind. He had to be clear and refreshed before he could sit back and relax. However, as a demigod in the lightning strike realm, he suddenly sensed that a person who was indispensable in his life was also advancing to the lightning strike realm, and it became clear to him in an instant;
"With swords and magic weapons, you don't need to protect me, but protect Princess Tiemu Huyan Nana. She was the concubine of Emperor Jintian in the previous life. Oh, you just know that she is your heroine. I can't let her lonely reincarnation for ten thousand years be in vain. Go!"
The sword-machine weapon devoured the endless thunder and lightning energy to restore stronger combat power. Satisfied, it streaked across the sky like a meteor towards the grassland of the Ironwood Tribe. No one needs guidance, because it is the main battle weapon of the Emperor Jintian Emperor, and Princess Huyan Nana is the only concubine of the Jintian Emperor who personally conferred the title of Emperor Jintian.
I haven't seen the heroine in more than a million years, and I am very excited about the sword and magic weapon. But the sky was full of thunder and lightning with super burning energy, and it felt like it was still devouring it. He slowed down and swallowed so much that he wished he could swallow the whole sky in one mouthful. Born under the underworld and hell, his heart was higher than the sky and his life was more precious than gold.
However, the Emperor Ziyun slowed down amid the soaring layers of thunder clouds and lightning clouds. Silver snakes danced wildly all over the sky, and thunder dragons soared wildly, hitting the Emperor Ziyun head-on. The army of Di Ziyun's thoughts and souls flew out in thousands in an instant, one holding a lightning thunder dragon and gnawing wildly, making the gods of all worlds hiding in the sky dumbfounded.
Including the Anti-god Heavenly Court, the False God Sacred, such a world-destroying thunder method is unprecedented. However, with such horror as Lei Fa, the false god in the world broke through the lightning strike realm in one fell swoop, and he accepted Lei Fa's righteous cosmic hegemony, and Ta Niang was almost swallowing Lei Fa back. Is this still a human being?
In fact, including the false gods of the Anti-god Heaven, they all looked down upon this human demigod. They could tell that Di Ziyun was over two thousand years old. To be promoted to Demigod just over 2,000 years old is so ordinary to all the worlds, so ordinary that an older young man is generally useless before he has found a wife.
Generally, the true pride of heaven will be punished by thunder in a thousand years. However, Emperor Zi Yuncai was in the lightning strike realm, more than a thousand years behind the Thousand-Year Thunder Punishment God, and he was already a piece of garbage in cultivation.
Of course, when they saw this cultivation garbage, it was so terrifying that it would destroy the world forever.During the thunder method, and the unprecedented weird thunder method of dismembering the body, the false gods in the anti-god heaven were dumbfounded. This damn man is not a human, but a monster.
Therefore, they made up their mind to smash this monster who was still under the demigod's thunder in the cradle. They believe that the deeds of the lowly human race in the lower realms will surely be captured by the gods above.
As a result, he waited for an opportunity to move between the fifth thunderbolts, and just as Di Ziyun expected, the sacred black hand of Nishen Tianting arrived unexpectedly. However, their tragedy can be imagined, this is an unprecedented thunderstorm, and it is about to break out.
The stronger thunder corresponding to Di Ziyun's heaven-defying evildoer instantly turned the counterfeit god's lightning strike into gray smoke, which was swallowed by Di Ziyun and became the nourishment for Di Ziyun's advancement.
Most of the pseudo-gods in the God-defying Heaven are descendants of gods or ancient gods, which is a great supplement. They can comprehensively improve Di Ziyun's body and magical powers. Di Ziyun's intentions are still unfinished. Unfortunately, the thunder that filled the sky fell, and Di Ziyun had to deal with the thunder. And the god-defying Heavenly Court had to stay away from this terrifying monster.
~~~The ninth thunderbolt of Emperor Ziyun was unprecedented. Layers of thunder clouds and lightning clouds filled the sky, layer by layer, like dragons falling from the sky, making Emperor Ziyun unable to guard against it. Even if the heavens did not dismember his body, the terrifying and extinct thunder would still tear his flesh and blood apart.
However, how could he bear to let his cosmic hegemonic body have even the slightest bit of deficiency, and his parents, who were affected by his skin and hair, swallowed them all back together with the thunder and lightning energy. Di Ziyun still refused to give up. While accepting the righteous way of Lei Fa, he stubbornly flew into the sky.
He found that the thunder and lightning clouds were getting thicker and thicker, and when he flew to the ninety-ninth floor, the thunder and lightning clouds were like an iron wall, but Di Ziyun did not give up at all. It was so mysterious that he had to find out.
"Star Thunder Sword Gang, broken!". Unable to bear it, Di Ziyun summoned the ancient Qingfeng sword to withstand the thunder dragon and silver snake in the sky and slashed at the ninety-ninth thunder cloud. In order to break through the ninety-ninth cloud, Di Ziyun spent ninety-nine days.
Finally, while he was slashing hard with the Xingchen Sword Gang, he could not waste it, even the chopped thunder clouds were swallowed up. When he was so tired that he vomited blood, the thick thunder clouds finally opened a crack, and the ray light was like a backlight, almost blinding the Emperor Ziyun.
These rays of light represent the original source of stronger electric currents and lightning strikes. Di Ziyun took the magic medicine to stabilize some of the light in his eyes;
"My, mine, waiting to knead this master like this will definitely grind his bones and muscles first, hurt his skin and flesh, and then wait for me to come and devour them all. The origin of thunder and lightning, this master is my only one, who can compete with me?"
The emperor's son Yunbi's eyes lit up when he saw the emperor's little fairy. He opened the gap with the crazy star sword and squeezed in through the gap with one foot without waiting. "Fuck, go ahead, grandma!"
However, the foot that Di Ziyun forced his way into the ninety-ninth floor felt like it was smashed into pieces by the thunderous blow. The source of the lightning strike spread throughout his body, and all he could see was that the electric current was like a silver dragon floating around. Di Ziyun just wanted to say, numb, numb, and the body is no longer his own.
"Is there any justice? The feet are not even my own!" Di Ziyun forced the lightning current to penetrate his whole body and pulled it out with both hands and legs.
Looking at the thigh that was hit hard by an unknown object and became as mutilated as a broom, the origin of lightning was like black gold and mercury slurry covered, the legs and feet were completely numb, and the eyebrows were raised upside down;
"Watt, if you dare to maim me, the sky will break..."
